meta: How to give coworkers feedback without hurt feelings: a valid point can still upset someone if it sounds like a personal attack.

muc.title: Right but still hurtful
muc.text: Feedback to coworkers often hurts not because the point is wrong, but because the wording sounds like a personal attack.

muc.title: Situation, impact, suggestion
muc.text: Easy-to-hear feedback has three parts: the specific thing that happened, its impact, and a suggestion for next time.

muc.title: Let AI soften it
muc.text: Write a blunt draft, remove names, then ask a chatbot to make it polite while keeping the full point.

muc.title: Your own voice
muc.text: AI often sounds too formal. Read it aloud, fix it into your own voice, and give feedback privately, not in front of the group.

muc.title: Feedback you still owe
muc.text: Think of feedback you meant to give but didn't, and ask AI to rewrite it in the three parts above.

thu: Think of feedback you meant to give but didn't, and ask AI to rewrite it in 3 parts: situation, impact, suggestion.
